name: Team Fortress 2
description: Team Fortress 2 dedicated server (Steam app 232250, native Linux, anonymous login). Port 27015 carries the game (UDP) and RCON (TCP) and is mirrored. A Game Server Login Token (GSLT) is recommended. Uses the 64-bit launcher srcds_run_64 (the current TF2 server); if your install only has the 32-bit srcds_run, duplicate this definition and change the first launch argument. SourceTV and Workshop maps are not handled.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser (hostname convar).

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Password players need to join (sv_password). Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Remote console password (rcon_password), also needed by external admin tools. Leave empty to have one generated when the server is created (20 characters); managers can read and regenerate it in Settings.

variables.label: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Steam game server login token, 32 hexadecimal characters, created at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers for app 440. Optional but strongly recommended: without it the server may run as an anonymous, unlisted or restricted server.

variables.label: Starting map
variables.description: Map the server starts on (for example ctf_2fort, cp_badlands, pl_upward, koth_harvest_final). The map must exist on the server.

ready.logRegex: Connection to Steam servers successful|gameserver Steam ID
